<Rep. Robert C. "Bobby" Scott, Rep. Frederica S. Wilson, Rep. Suzanne Bonamici, Rep. Mark DeSaulnier, Rep. Jahana Hayes>: Committee Democrats generally support the idea of creating a standardized financial aid award letter. Some Members even voted to report H.R. 6502 to the House floor, recognizing the bill as a step in the right direction to be improved upon as the legislative process continues. However, many Committee Democrats remain concerned the bill includes language that could confuse potential students as they review their financial aid offers and decide which college is the best financial fit for them and their families. We urge Committee Republicans to work in a bipartisan fashion to make changes as described in these views before the final bill is considered in the House of Representatives.
Robert C. ``Bobby'' Scott,
Ranking Member.
Frederica S. Wilson,
Suzanne Bonamici,
Mark DeSaulnier,
Jahana Hayes,
Members of Congress.
